title: MCP Plugin Server Deduplication

evaluation.reasoning: Already shipped automatic behavior — MCP servers provided by plugins that match a manually-configured server (same command/URL) are now silently skipped, preventing duplicate tool exposure. Integration complexity 100 (no action needed). Community validation 90 (official Claude Code changelog). Capability expansion 40 reflects the narrow applicability (only affects setups with both plugin AND manual MCP config for the same server), making it an infrastructure fix rather than a capability class expansion. Token efficiency 60 because reducing duplicate tools reduces context noise and tool disambiguation overhead. Registry annotation is the correct action.
